summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The ETC 6 Meridian Small Cap Equity ETF (SIXS) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in small-cap stocks. The fund is a portfolio of US small-caps with low beta and value characteristics, actively selected from the S&P 600. SIXS was launched on May 11, 2020 and is issued by Exchange Traded Concepts.

holdings.infoBox: SIXS is an equity ETF with a total of 86 individual holdings. The top holdings are International Seaways stock at 2.55%, Innoviva at 2.41%, Par Pacific Holdings at 2.32%, Assured Guaranty at 2.20%, and Cal-Maine Foods at 2.07%.
